observed_semantics: Part::Sweep owns Sections, Spine, Solid, Frenet, Linearize and Transition; constructor defaults Solid=true, Frenet=true, Transition=Right corner, Linearize=false
cad_core_s1_contract: Request TypeId Part::Sweep with native DocumentObject properties; do not route through a synthetic adapter shape

observed_semantics: Sweep::execute rejects empty Sections as "No sections linked.", missing Spine as "No spine", null or invalid Spine/SubList as "Invalid spine", and invalid section links as "Invalid section link"
cad_core_s1_contract: S1 diagnostics should preserve these source boundaries before entering OCCT; invalid payloads must not fabricate expected shapes

observed_semantics: Sweep resolves Spine with ResolveLink|Transform, then optional Spine.getSubValues() are resolved by getSubTopoShape() and reassembled through makeElementCompound(... returnShape) before shapes[0]
cad_core_s1_contract: S1 must parse App::PropertyLinkSub value plus optional SubList and pass the resolved spine as the first PipeShell source

observed_semantics: Sections is App::PropertyLinkList; prepareProfiles accepts single face via splitWires, edge collections via makeElementWires, single wire, and single vertex; other shapes raise "Profile shape is not a single vertex, edge, wire nor face."
cad_core_s1_contract: S1 first batch uses one profile but should keep the helper boundary aligned with FreeCAD rather than hard-coding only a fixture profile

observed_semantics: Transition enum order is Transformed, Right corner, Round corner; Solid maps to MakeSolid::makeSolid/noSolid; Frenet maps to SetMode(Standard_True/False); Transition maps to BRepBuilderAPI_Transformed/RightCorner/RoundCorner
cad_core_s1_contract: S1 fields and expected payload should expose solid, frenet and transition values, including the FreeCAD default Right corner

observed_semantics: makeElementPipeShell requires at least two shapes, converts the first to a single wire, Add()s prepared profiles, checks IsReady(), Build()s, optionally MakeSolid(), then returns makeElementShape(...)
cad_core_s1_contract: S1 geometry helper belongs under Part/topo shape code, not adapter output repair

observed_semantics: makeElementShape wraps the PipeShell maker with MapperMaker, which reads Modified() and Generated() history; AppPartPy explicitly avoids GeomFill_Pipe because it has no shape history
cad_core_s1_contract: S1 must publish a PipeShell maker-history marker and assert source spine/profile history; final bbox parity is insufficient

observed_semantics: Part.makeSweepSurface(path, profile, tolerance) is a low-level helper that calls makeElementPipeShell with noSolid, Frenet=false and Transformed, mainly because makeSweep has no history
cad_core_s1_contract: It can help oracle probes, but supported capability must remain source-backed Part::Sweep DocumentObject

observed_semantics: FreeCAD exposes advanced PipeShell wrapper modes and cad-core Hole ModelThread uses BRepOffsetAPI_MakePipeShell internally, but these are not Part::Sweep execute() semantics
cad_core_s1_contract: Do not publish auxiliary spine, located profile, support mode, trihedron/binormal, GUI dialog or Hole ModelThread as Part::Sweep support
